findings.claim: t2Check only looks for the placeholder inside a 'String sql = ...;' declaration. A correct rewrite that passes the literal directly, conn.prepareStatement("SELECT id, name, city FROM customers WHERE city = ?"), is rejected with the false diagnosis 'The SQL text needs a placeholder' (verified by running t2Check in node).
findings.recommendation: Also accept a placeholder in the prepareStatement(...) string literal (search the prepareStatement argument when no sql variable is declared), or state in the task that the sql variable must be kept.
